'''Baskol Yeesrim''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] who served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]], and later as one of [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe's]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representatives]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Yeesrim offered [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] an ornate, ceremonial Gran [[wind drum]] from an ancient spiritual era. Palpatine kept it on display in his [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|apartment suite]] in [[500 Republica/Legends|''500 Republica'']]. Yeesrim was also increasingly anti-[[Dug/Legends|Dug]], due to the larger political standing of Gran in [[Malastare/Legends|Malastarian]] hierarchy.<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File">''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]''</ref>
During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Yeesrim supported Senator Moe's decision for a commission to be sent to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to verify [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] claims against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] blockade of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

Following Moe's assassination in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Yeesrim went on to serve the Senator's successor, [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] along with [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]].

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']] Senator [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] was mistakenly referred to as Baskol Yeesrim. In [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], he is referred to as the aide of "Senator [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]]".
